name: build-feature
description: From a written request to a verified delivery: requirements, architecture and ADRs, (approval), plan, test-first implementation, quality gates with a fix loop, parallel code and security review, fixes, documentation and a delivery report with traceability.

request.description: What to build: the requirements as you would write them for a team.

stack.default: Use what the repository already uses; otherwise choose a mainstream stack with few dependencies.

approval.description: "auto" to skip the design approval step, "manual" to approve requirements and architecture before building.

analystModel.description: Model for the analyst and the architect (optional; another model than the conversation's is a delegation).

engineerModel.description: Model for the planner and the engineer (optional).

reviewerModel.description: Model for the code and security reviewers (optional; a second opinion from another provider).

requirements.title: Requirements

architecture.title: Architecture & ADRs

approve-design.title: Approve the design

plan.title: Implementation plan
plan.prompt:
Write docs/plan.md for docs/requirements.md and docs/architecture.md.

Report: the task list in one line per task.

implement.title: Implement (test-first)
implement.prompt:
Implement docs/plan.md, task by task, test-first, following docs/architecture.md. Every requirement in docs/requirements.md must be implemented and covered by tests. Run the quality_gates tool before you finish and fix what fails.

Report: what you built (files), the test command and its result.

fix.title: Fix failing gates

code-review.title: Code review
code-review.prompt: Review the implementation against docs/requirements.md. Write docs/reviews/code-review.md.

security-review.title: Security review
security-review.prompt: Review the implementation for security problems. Write docs/reviews/security-review.md.

address-review.title: Address review findings

fix-final.title: Fix failing gates
fix-final.prompt:
The quality gates failed after the review fixes. Fix the root causes.

{{feedback}}

docs.title: Documentation
docs.prompt: Write or update README.md (what it is, setup, configuration, usage with runnable examples, API reference with request/response examples, how to test) and add an entry to CHANGELOG.md. Confirm every command you document actually works.

deliver.title: Delivery report
